title: The List That Changed Nowhere: What JavaScript Does to a List Property, and the Model That Says So

questions.question: JavaScript pushes onto a QVariantList property. What does C++ see?
options: Nothing: the push went to a copy, and no signal was emitted
questions.explanation: The QVariantList stayed at size 2 with 0 signals.

questions.question: Does the same push onto a QStringList property reach C++?
options: On Qt 6.2 it did: a sequence type is a reference and is written back
questions.explanation: The QStringList had 3, with 1 changed signal.

questions.question: A model adds to its vector and does not call beginInsertRows. What does a Repeater show?
options: The old rows: it was never told
questions.explanation: The silent model had 2 rows and its view 1 item.

questions.question: What does begin and end around a change tell a view?
options: Which rows are new, so that it creates items for exactly those

questions.question: A delegate wants to read the value of its row. What is needed?
options: A role in roleNames, named value
questions.explanation: The delegate read 20.5 through the name value.

questions.question: What does clear emit?
questions.explanation: clear was 1 reset and an empty Repeater.
